was: City of Chisholm campground at the St. Louis County Fairgrounds, across from the MN Discovery Center and Redhead Mountain Bike Park trailhead (distinct from Chisholm's Iron Trail campground). 16 RV sites with 50/30/15-amp power and water (no sewer; on-site dump station). note: City of Chisholm campground at the St. Louis County Fairgrounds, across from the Minnesota Discovery Center and the Redhead Mountain Bike Park trailhead (distinct from the city's Iron Trail campground in town).  16 back-in sites, 40 ft wide by 50 ft long, with water and 30/50-amp electric but no sewer; the city lists restrooms, hot showers, a dump station and picnic tables, and guests may also use the showers at the Iron Trail campground. was: City of Edmond park on Arcadia Lake (a city park, NOT a state park despite the name): Cottonwood full-hookup loop (RVs to 50 ft), Bobcat and Kingsnake primitive loops nearer the water; showers, boat ramp, swim beach. Reservable online. --Claude
note: City of Edmond park on Arcadia Lake, not a state park despite the name: 249 acres with full-hookup, regular (electric and community water) and primitive sites, a shower, a courtesy dock and boat ramp, a swim beach, two playgrounds, three pavilions and hiking trails.
